final: WITH r AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_len, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS ppd FROM film GROUP BY rating), m AS (SELECT AVG(ppd) AS mean_ppd FROM r) SELECT AVG(r.avg_len) AS avg_length, AVG(r.ppd) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(r.ppd - m.mean_ppd) AS avg_excess FROM r, m WHERE r.ppd > m.mean_ppd
